verdict.rationale: Rippling's docs confirm paying contractors globally without waiting on bank transfers/conversion and unifying global payroll in one system, implying local currency payouts, but there is no explicit mention of compliant contractor agreements/contract generation or EOR/compliance guarantees specific to contractors. missing for 10: explicit evidence of compliant contractor agreement templates or localized contract compliance, independent/hands-on verification of local-currency payouts, and any detail on contractor misclassification protections.
